scope: Synthetic onsite suggestions only, not verified access, availability or safety clearance.

activities.title: Explore facilities and settle in
activities.description: After settling in, check campsite notices and locate the kitchen, water facilities and rubbish storage. Observe colours around your pitch, alone or with companions, with rest breaks. No pool visit or off-site activity is scheduled.

activities.title: Campsite observations and relaxation
activities.description: Observe the surroundings from your settled pitch, record impressions and take rest breaks. Stay within the campsite and avoid wildlife habitats.

activities.title: Pitch setup and meal preparation
activities.description: Organise your tent area and belongings. Locate showers, water and rubbish facilities. Follow fire rules when preparing meals. Try a nature-colour observation game or travel quiz at your pitch, with breaks.

activities.title: Leisure and photography at your pitch
activities.description: Read, take photographs or share stories at your pitch, leaving time to rest. No water activity or beach route is scheduled.

activities.title: Settle in and organise drinking water
activities.description: Organise the drinking water and meal supplies you brought and read campsite notices. Do not treat on-site water as directly drinkable. Try a shape-spotting game or share stories at your pitch. Swimming is not scheduled.

activities.title: Rest and travel reflections
activities.description: Rest at your pitch, record observations and organise supplies for the next day. No water activity or unregistered trail is scheduled.

activities.title: Pack up and prepare for return
activities.description: Check personal equipment, sort and take all rubbish, and inspect your pitch. Leave according to actual check-out requirements and verified transport arrangements. Suggested times are not service schedules or check-out commitments.

activities.title: Travel stories and quiet rest

activities.title: Harbour-themed storytelling
activities.description: Imagine a harbour or travel story, alone or with companions, then rest quietly at your pitch. This is a suggested game, not an island event, venue visit, tour or ferry arrangement.

activities.title: Word games and rest
activities.description: Choose word chains, travel questions or personal reflections at your pitch, with breaks. No additional props are required. Do not enter woodland or unregistered trails.
